finding: The headline coefficient survives every deployment-like split we can construct. Holding out an entire age band costs 0.05; holding out a sex costs 0.07-0.09; predicting the cognitive extremes from the middle 60% actually scores HIGHER (0.656).
significance: This rules out the three main ways a connectome-cognition number can be inflated: random-split luck, family leakage across ages, and easy regression-to-the-middle predictions.
